The SNAXK judgement loop.

1
Sense

Collect signals from people, agents, systems and context.

→
2
Assess

Test evidence against intent, boundaries and risk.

→
3
Judge

Decide: proceed, adjust, escalate, or stop.

→
4
Act

Execute within boundaries with measurements.

→
5
Review

Compare outcomes, capture learning, tighten the loop.

Boundaries make it safe to move fast.

Ownership

Clear accountable owner for the outcome and the call.

Scope

What's in, what's out, and what needs human judgement.

Evidence

Minimum evidence required to justify the next step.

Stop Conditions

Trigger points that pause or stop automated work.

Review Cadence

How often we renew, revalidate, and recalibrate.

Built for the Chief Agentic Officer.

SNAXK gives CAOs and boards a judgement layer they can read and rely on.

  • Board-readable judgement summaries
  • Decision trails people and agents can both read
  • Bounded autonomy with clear escalation paths
  • Signals that surface risk before it becomes cost
  • Operational cadence that sustains performance
